scope:
Open Atrium: shipping renderer/input with controlled scenes, not human QA.
The browser runs actual standalone / dist modules via documented in-memory
transport. No artwork, UI, gameplay, scoring or rendering function is replaced.

tests.name: Matching 3.6.4 identity and exact non-diagnostic startup
Both bounded atmosphere surfaces are built under loading, before the first key
Actual raster leaves near shelves, columns, desk and all four stage edges untouched
Feather is continuous in actual pixels; the old sheet top/bottom no longer forms an alpha edge
Original painted depth survives while central green saturation is reduced, without a bright haze
High contrast darkens background pixels without altering the feather boundary
All 48 chapters and both contrast settings share a calm center without changing simulation or growing caches
No extra DOM screen, extra input field or duplicate UI canvas is introduced
60 live rendered frames perform zero pixel readbacks after loading
120 accessibility toggles reuse the same two surfaces and preserve the current run
1920x1080: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap
1440x900: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap
1366x768: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap
1280x720: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap
1024x768: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap
1024x600: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap
800x600: high-pressure words and existing HUD fit without a new panel or overlap

Real input, Backspace and exact-word priority still work over the open chamber
FIRE: actual keyboard cast, input selection, score and resources are unchanged
ICE: actual keyboard cast, input selection, score and resources are unchanged
SLOW: actual keyboard cast, input selection, score and resources are unchanged
WIND: actual keyboard cast, input selection, score and resources are unchanged
ICE expiry and queued SLOW keep their original timing against the new background
Pause and resume preserve simulation, partial effects and static atmosphere
Reduced motion retains a static readable environment, with no moving mist or light sweep
Twelve live cards at 95 percent paper pressure remain single-row and readable
The first keystroke does not rebuild or synchronously process backdrop pixels
A fresh atmosphere instance builds exactly two bounded surfaces; cold cost is recorded
Unavailable original art cannot create a substitute rectangle or throw from the atmosphere
The final word clears Chapter 5 and opens Chapter 6 without an atmosphere rebuild
Actual rendered chapter and gameplay previews use the shipping painter
Completed Open Atrium suite has zero unhandled page exceptions
